properties.summary: My mom was deported, and I felt like I was constantly worrying about her. I had a hard time concentrating in class because I was always thinking about whether she was okay and when I would be able to see her again. Even now, whenever I hear about ICE, I get anxious because it reminds me of what happened.
properties.support_need: Accessible mental health care and trusted community spaces

properties.summary: My older brother was deported, and our relationship changed completely. We used to see each other all the time, but now most of our relationship happens through phone calls. I missed being able to spend holidays and important moments with him, and it has been difficult knowing that I can't just visit him whenever I want.
properties.support_need: Family resource support and legal guidance

properties.summary: My partner was deported, and it put a lot of financial pressure on both of us. We had shared expenses, and suddenly I had to take on more of them while also trying to stay focused on school. I started working more hours, which left me with less time for studying and made college much harder to manage.
properties.support_need: Emergency aid and long-term financial support

properties.impact_theme: Disruption to education and everyday life
properties.summary: After my relative was deported, my responsibilities at home changed a lot. I had to help my family with things that they had previously handled, and it became harder to keep up with school. There were days when I wanted to focus on classes but couldn't because I was worried about what was happening with my family. My everyday routine felt completely different afterward.

After my friend's deportation, I became much more hesitant to talk about immigration with other people. I was worried that people would make assumptions about them or about my family, so I started keeping more things to myself. I also became more aware of how easily immigration status can become something people judge you for. It was isolating because I didn't feel comfortable explaining why the deportation affected me so much.
properties.support_need: Community spaces that reduce stigma and encourage dialogue
